in_greek.name: Νολλία
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Nollia is derived from the Greek word νολλός (nollos), meaning 'rest' or 'repose'. This name is a fitting choice for a child who brings peace and calmness to those around them.

in_latin.name: Nollia
